proof.text: At $A_{E,n}$ use the finite normalization of [lem-pod-identity-compactification-system-mate]. The identity-open identification makes $Ra^c_!=Ra_*$ and the open exchange the identity, including the specified source and target comparisons. Substitution in the two-arrow definition [def-weil-frobenius-square-exchange] gives $\kappa_{Lg_Y^*M}\operatorname{FrEx}_{Y,!}(M)=\operatorname{FrEx}_{Y,*}(M)Lg_s^*\kappa_M$, proving clause 1 at finite coefficients.

source.place: ## Proof, Step 6: 'it is Frobenius-equivariant because both operators are those of Step 5', asserted without argument; cf. Deligne, La conjecture de Weil I (literature/deligne-weil-I_PMIHES-1974-43.pdf), (1.3) p. 274 ('Pour X propre, les deux coincident') and (1.12) p. 278

proof.text:
Integrally, [lem-pod-identity-compactification-system-mate] identifies the strict towers, including quotient transitions, and gives $h_Te_a^c=e_ah_S$ before $R\varprojlim$. The two comparison equations of [lem-pod-identity-compactification-limit-comparisons] therefore give
$$\kappa_{M'}\beta_!\mathcal L_s(e_a^c)\alpha_!=\beta_*\mathcal L_s(h_Te_a^c)\alpha_!=\beta_*\mathcal L_s(e_ah_S)\alpha_!=\beta_*\mathcal L_s(e_a)\alpha_*Lg_s^*\kappa_M,$$
where $M'=Lg_Y^*M$. These are the exchange formulas of [def-weil-frobenius-square-exchange], so clause 1 holds for $\mathcal O_E$. Scalar localization preserves the equality for $E$; a common finite field representative gives it for $\Qlb$, using the specified coefficient passage in that definition. No equality is inferred from finite evaluations.

source.place: ## Proof, Step 6: 'it is Frobenius-equivariant because both operators are those of Step 5', asserted without argument; cf. Deligne, La conjecture de Weil I (literature/deligne-weil-I_PMIHES-1974-43.pdf), (1.3) p. 274 ('Pour X propre, les deux coincident') and (1.12) p. 278

proof.text:
Put $F=\operatorname{Fib}_s$, $G=Lg_s^*$, $N_!=Ra_{Y!}M$, $N_*=Ra_{Y*}M$, and $M'=Lg_Y^*M$. Clause 2 of [lem-weil-frobenius-point-transport-natural], applied to $\kappa_M:N_!\to N_*$, gives $\iota_{N_*}F(\kappa_M)=F(G\kappa_M)\iota_{N_!}$. Functoriality of $F$ [def-weil-finite-coefficient-point] and clause 1 now give
$$\tau_MF(\kappa_M)=F(\operatorname{FrEx}_{Y,*})F(G\kappa_M)\iota_{N_!}=F(\kappa_{M'})F(\operatorname{FrEx}_{Y,!})\iota_{N_!}=F(\kappa_{M'})\tau_{c,M}.$$
The endpoints are the transport composites of [def-weil-frobenius-cohomology-transport].
